status: Independent physical backing evidence only; acceptance decision belongs to parent reviewer. Strict original-normal thickness still fails.

method.coordinate_transform: Exact source rotation/translation, no geometry changes; original STL float32 triangles preserved
method.box_proof: All 7080 original boundary triangles strictly disjoint from each closed oriented box by full 13-axis triangle/box SAT in long double (ambiguity tolerance 1e-9 mm), plus full-original-mesh long-double compensated solid-angle winding at centre = 1. This proves whole box interior material, not merely sampled points.
method.direction_selection: Only print -Z and known source wall/core axes. Selected before intersection measurements; no angular maximum search.
method.slice_limit: 1e-8 mm endpoint joining for figure only; original segment coordinates and face IDs retained.
method.global_limit: Does not establish global minimum wall thickness, strength, or general manufacturability.
